changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names to canonical forms (NUCLE, CoNLL-2014). Removed redundant model mentions and simplified output descriptions.
Normalized metric names to standard forms and removed redundant entries. All metrics mentioned are used for evaluating GEC outputs.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges for evaluation. BERT and ELECTRA are used as encoders/backbones for the quality estimation model, not as post-hoc evaluators.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. All evaluations are automated using metrics like F0.5, Precision, Recall, etc.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) quality estimation using multiple hypotheses. It proposes VERNet, which uses BERT/ELECTRA as backbone encoders to estimate the quality of GEC outputs. The evaluation is entirely automated using standard GEC metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of dataset names and metric variants.
